svg.title: Crane operator — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as crane operator, wearing a work jacket and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A two-button crane control pendant is paired with a separate suspended lifting hook. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
